basic_info.description: 4234 24th Street is a newly built architectural showpiece on Noe Valley's main corridor, featured on national TV for its custom design, luxury finishes, and striking appeal. Spanning 4,912sqft across four levels, this residence offers 7 bedrooms (including multiple primary suites), 5 full + 2 half baths, and decks or patios on every level, all connected by a private elevator. Designed for modern, tech-forward living, it includes iPad-controlled smart systems, Sonos surround sound, radiant heating, air recovery, SPAN smart panel, and dual EV chargers. A chef's kitchen with butler's pantry, Gaggenau appliances, and Taj Mahal marble anchors the main entertaining space, enhanced by sleek bio-ethanol fireplaces and seamless indoor/outdoor flow to a spacious backyard. The versatile layout offers main living above and a guest/in-law suite below ideal for multigenerational living. A legal 2-unit building with flexible single-family use, this rare property blends luxury, technology, and functionality just steps from boutique shops, cafes, and top-rated schools in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
